1003.description: A squat combined with a band row, pulling the handles as you stand. It works the legs and back.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest lifted.
From the squat position, pull the band handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
面向锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
双手握住弹力带手柄，手掌相对，双臂向前伸展。
弯曲膝盖并蹲下，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
从蹲姿开始，将弹力带手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1067.description: Pull a cable down with straight arms. It isolates the lats.
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the bar.
Hinge slightly forward.
Pull the bar down to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.

1131.description: A lunge stepping out to the side and across, with straps for support, training the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step one leg out and slightly behind the other, crossing the body.
Sink back into the hip with a flat back.
Push through the working foot to return.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Switch sides after your reps.

1195.description: Pressing on an incline chest machine with neutral hammer handles. It builds the upper chest and is gentle on the shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.

1259.description: A stretch with the hands behind the head, pulling the elbows back. It opens the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Interlace your fingers behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Slowly squeeze your shoulder blades together and push your chest forward.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat as desired.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将手指交叉放在脑后，肘部朝外。
慢慢地将肩胛骨挤压在一起，并将胸部向前推。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒。
松开拉伸并根据需要重复。

1323.description: A seated row with a rope attachment on a cable station. The neutral grip works the upper back, lats and biceps.
instructions: Sit on the rowing machine with your feet flat on the footrests and knees slightly bent.
Grasp the cable ropes with an overhand grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward, maintaining a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the cable ropes towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住缆绳，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直，稍微向前倾斜，肘部保持轻微弯曲。
将缆绳拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1387.description: A one-leg calf raise on the floor with a hand on a wall for balance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a wall or sturdy object for balance.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，双手放在墙壁或坚固的物体上以保持平衡。
将一只脚抬离地面并用另一只脚保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚跟抬离地面，将身体抬起到脚掌上。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将脚跟放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换腿并重复。

1451.description: A seated dip on a lever machine that mimics the dip motion with guided support. It targets the triceps and also works the chest and front delts.
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your feet are flat on the ground and your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
Grasp the handles of the leverage machine with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，使双脚平放在地面上，膝盖呈 90 度角。
手掌朝下，抓住杠杆机的手柄，双臂完全伸展。
弯曲肘部，慢慢降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1515.description: A deadlift performed with a clean-style setup and path. It trains the pulling position used in the clean.
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip just outside your knees.
Set a flat back, chest up and shoulders over the bar.
Push the floor away to lift the bar, keeping it close to your legs.
Stand tall with hips and knees fully extended.
Lower the bar back down with control along the same path.

1579.description: A hack squat on the sled using one leg at a time. It isolates each quad and glute with solid back support.
instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat sled with your back and shoulders against the pads.
Place one foot in the middle of the platform and keep the other foot off.
Release the safety and lower by bending your working knee.
Go as deep as you can with control.
Press up through your heel, then switch legs after your reps.

1643.description: A seated curl at a high cable stack with your arms overhead. It stresses the biceps in a different way.
instructions: Sit on a bench facing the cable machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the cable attachment with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms stationary and your elbows close to your sides.
Exhale and curl the cable attachment towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the cable attachment back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，面向电缆机，双脚平放在地面上。
用手握住电缆附件，手掌朝上，双手与肩同宽。
保持上臂不动，肘部靠近身体两侧。
呼气并将电缆附件卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将电缆附件放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1707.description: A twisting motion lying face down on a stability ball. It trains the abs and obliques.
instructions: Start by lying face down on a stability ball with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes touching the ground.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core muscles and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, keeping your back straight.
Rotate your torso to one side, bringing your shoulder towards your hip. Keep your hips and legs stable throughout the movement.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，面朝下躺在稳定球上，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾接触地面。
将双手放在脑后或交叉放在胸前。
启动核心肌肉，慢慢将上半身抬离球，保持背部挺直。
将躯干旋转到一侧，使肩膀靠近臀部。在整个运动过程中保持臀部和腿部稳定。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
重复旋转到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1771.description: A kneeling bodyweight triceps press with elbows kept tight to your sides. Builds triceps strength without equipment.
instructions: Kneel down on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you, shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs straight behind you, balancing on your toes and hands, forming a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your upper body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 跪在地上，膝盖分开与臀部同宽。
将双手放在身前的地面上，与肩同宽，手指指向前方。
将双腿伸直在身后，用脚趾和双手保持平衡，从头到脚跟形成一条直线。
弯曲肘部，将上半身向地面降低，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
在底部停顿片刻，然后双手用力伸直手臂，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1835.description: Seated chin-to-chest stretch for the muscles along the back of the neck.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with your hands resting in your lap.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Let the weight of your head do the work, without forcing it.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lift your head back to neutral slowly.

1899.description: A wide side lunge that stretches the inner thigh of the straight leg.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat.
Keep your chest tall.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1963.description: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole outward.
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently outward.
Feel the stretch along the top and outer edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2091.description: A stretch for the top of the forearm with the fingers pointing down.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so the fingers point toward the floor.
Use your other hand to press the back of the hand gently toward you.
Keep your elbow straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2155.description: A side plank from the knees with a band, training the sides of the waist and the hips with less load than a full plank.
instructions: Wrap a band around your thighs and lie on one side with your knees bent.
Place your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Push your top knee gently out against the band.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2283.description: A plate-loaded neck exercise that bends the head sideways to the left to strengthen the side neck muscles.
instructions: Set the weight light and position the pad against the left side of your head.
Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the left against the resistance.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Return slowly to the centre.
Repeat for the planned reps with control.

2347.description: A front plank form check that compares a raised butt with a straight body line.
instructions: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the floor.
Lift your body into a straight line from head to heels.
Avoid pushing your butt up or letting your hips sag.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to keep the line.
Hold for 20-40 seconds and breathe steadily.

2411.description: Seated with a harness attached to a cable, you pull your head back against steady resistance to train the neck extensors.
instructions: Fit the head harness and sit facing the cable with it attached at head height.
Start with your head tipped slightly forward.
Pull your head back until it is upright.
Pause, then return slowly against the cable.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.

2475.description: A single-leg bridge with the free knee bent toward your chest.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor and the other knee pulled up.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

2731.description: Throwing a heavy weight up and over a high bar. It is an explosive power move that trains hips, back and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold the weight with both hands low in front of you, feet shoulder width apart.
Swing it back between your legs while hinging at the hips.
Drive your hips and legs up hard and swing the weight up and overhead.
Release it over the bar, then step back and reset for the next throw.

2795.description: A step up that flows into a lunge while holding dumbbells. Builds single leg strength and balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Step one foot onto the box and drive up until you stand on it.
Step the same foot back down behind you into a lunge.
Push back up to the start, keeping your torso upright.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch sides.

2859.description: A rolling move that massages the spine and trains abdominal control.
instructions: Sit with your knees tucked and hold your shins.
Round your back.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll back up to balance.
Keep your chin tucked.

2987.description: A weighted close-grip chin-up on a dip cage. Builds the lats, biceps and upper back.
instructions: Stand in front of the dip cage and grab the parallel bars with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bars with your arms fully extended, feet off the ground, and body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bars, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bars, then pause for a moment.
Slowly lower your body back down to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在俯卧撑前面，用反握抓住双杠，双手与肩同宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，双脚离开地面，身体伸直。
收紧背部肌肉，将身体拉向杠铃，保持肘部靠近身体两侧。
继续拉，直到下巴高于杠铃，然后暂停片刻。
慢慢地将身体放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

3243.description: A lying stretch hugging both knees toward your chest to release the lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

3307.description: An explosive strongman lift where you heave a heavy keg up and over a bar behind you. It builds hip power and total body drive.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and the keg between your legs, gripping it low with both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keep your chest up and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the keg up your body.
Extend fully and throw the keg up and back over the bar.
Reset, step back to the start and repeat with control.

3371.description: Swinging the ropes from side to side to condition your shoulders and trunk.
instructions: Hold the rope ends in an athletic stance with knees bent.
Swing both ropes to one side.
Swing them across to the other side in a flowing motion.
Rotate through your torso a little.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.

3435.description: A one-leg hip bridge with the other leg held straight, strongly working glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat.
Extend the other leg straight.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Lower with control.
Switch legs after your set.

3499.description: A pullover-style move hanging under a bar, with the legs helping a bit. It builds the lats and shoulder strength.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar at hip height or lower and hang beneath it with an overhand grip.
Keep your feet on the floor to help as needed.
Pull your chest toward the bar and let your hips rise.
Continue to rotate your torso up and over the bar toward your hands, as your range allows.
Reverse slowly back to the start.
Use your legs only as needed.

3563.description: A one arm cable pulldown from a high pulley, pulling the handle down to your side. It trains the lats.
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handle with an overhand grip and extend your arm fully.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the handle down towards your side while keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your lat muscle.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other arm.
instructionsZh: 将单个手柄连接到高滑轮电缆机上。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住手柄并完全伸展手臂。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将手柄向一侧拉，同时保持肘部靠近身体。
在动作底部暂停片刻，挤压背阔肌。
慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用另一只手臂重复练习。

3691.description: A split squat holding one dumbbell at your chest. Great for working each leg on its own while the front load keeps you upright.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso tall and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Stop when your front thigh is about parallel to the ground.
Push through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3883.description: A seated machine crunch to the right side that trains the obliques.
instructions: Sit in the machine with the pads positioned for a right side crunch.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Exhale and crunch your torso toward the right.
Squeeze your side at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Avoid using momentum.

3947.description: A push-up where you lift your hands at the bottom, removing momentum and building chest strength.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your whole body to the floor.
Lift your hands off the floor briefly.
Place them back and press up.
Keep your body in a straight line.

4011.description: A bent over row with a cable and straight bar. It builds the lats and mid-back.
instructions: Face the low pulley and hinge forward holding the bar.
Keep a flat back.
Pull the bar toward your waist.
Squeeze your back.
Extend your arms slowly.

4075.description: Standing band fly bringing the hands together in front of the chest. It trains the pecs.
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold the ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Start with arms out to the sides and slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Return slowly under control.

4139.description: A second version of the band overhead extension for the triceps.
instructions: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other overhead with both hands.
Bend your elbows behind your head.
Extend your arms upward.
Keep your elbows close to your ears.
Lower under control.

4203.description: A wide stance deadlift with band resistance.
instructions: Set the band over the bar.
Stand wide.
Grip inside your legs.
Drive up.
Squeeze glutes.
Lower with control.

4331.description: A crunch where one leg lifts as you curl up. It adds a lower-abs challenge to the basic crunch.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Extend one leg and lift it a few inches off the floor.
Curl your shoulders up toward your hips.
Lower slowly, then repeat.
Switch legs halfway through or alternate each rep.

4395.description: A simple warm-up where you roll the shoulders in circles to loosen the upper back and shoulder joints.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms relaxed by your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Complete several slow circles.
Reverse the direction and repeat.

4459.description: A lying core move where you press your arms and legs together to crunch the abs. Targets the front of the trunk.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and legs extended.
Brace your abs and press your lower back to the floor.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees toward your chest.
Reach your hands to your knees and squeeze.
Return slowly without letting your feet touch down.
Repeat for reps.

4523.description: A balance-focused hip hinge on one leg with a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg.
Hinge forward at the hips while extending the free leg back.
Lower the kettlebell toward the floor with a flat back.
Keep your hips level and your standing knee slightly bent.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.

4587.description: A quick snapping front kick at a bag that trains speed and control in the thigh and hip.
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance facing the bag.
Raise your knee quickly.
Snap your lower leg out to hit the bag with the ball of your foot.
Recoil right away to bend the knee again.
Keep your hands up.
Set your foot down and switch sides.

4715.description: Lifting opposite arm and leg while face down to strengthen the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Raise your right arm and left leg.
Hold briefly and lower.
Raise your left arm and right leg.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly.

4779.description: Lying face up with your hands under your head, you do small alternating kicks. It works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back and place your hands under your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick up and down alternately in small, quick motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set time.

4843.description: A drop off a box into an immediate broad jump. It trains reactive leg power.
instructions: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Immediately explode forward into a broad jump.
Swing your arms for momentum.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

4907.description: A side plank with the top leg lifted, a second variation. It adds hip work to the oblique hold.
instructions: Set up in a side plank on your forearm with your body in a line.
Lift your top leg to hip height.
Keep your hips high and your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without dropping.
Lower down gently.
Repeat on the other side.

4971.description: A single leg Romanian deadlift without weight. It trains the hamstrings and balance.
instructions: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge forward as the other leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

5035.description: Back extension holding a weight at your chest. It trains the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set the pad at hip level on a hyperextension bench with your feet secured.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise it until your body forms a straight line.
Do not overarch at the top.

5099.description: Walk while carrying a kettlebell in one hand. It builds grip and demands a strong trunk to stay upright.
instructions: Pick up a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders level.
Walk with steady steps without leaning to the loaded side.
Walk for a set distance or time.
Switch hands and repeat.

5483.description: Seated calf raise with weight on your thighs that targets the soleus muscle under the calf.
instructions: Sit with the balls of your feet on a raised edge and weight resting on your knees.
Lower your heels until you feel a calf stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your knees bent throughout.

5803.description: Lie face down over a bench and lift your legs behind you. It strengthens the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hold the bench for support.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until level with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

5867.description: A bent over kettlebell row with a rotation as you pull. It trains the back and challenges the core.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Row one kettlebell toward your hip.
Rotate your torso slightly as you pull.
Lower the weight and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides for the set.

6059.description: A bent-over row with a bottle in each hand. It trains the mid back and lats.
instructions: Hold a bottle in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bottles toward your hips, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

6123.description: A single-arm shrug-style movement that trains the muscles that lift and control the shoulder blade. It helps shoulder stability.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your chest up.
Lift your shoulder blade straight up toward your ear.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6443.description: Seated leg circles that loosen up your hips and gently work the muscles around them.
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly on your hands.
Lift one leg a little off the floor.
Draw slow circles in the air with that foot.
Keep your core engaged and your torso steady.
Switch directions, then switch legs.

6763.description: A seated stretch for the muscles of the forearm. It eases tight wrists after typing or gripping.
instructions: Sit tall and extend one arm in front of you, palm up.
With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep the elbow straight and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Turn the palm down to stretch the other side, then switch arms.

6891.description: A seated floor press that alternates arms, which adds anti-lean trunk work. It trains the shoulders and the core.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it and press the other arm.
Keep alternating without tilting your torso.

7019.description: A kneeling rollout with the forearms on a stability ball. It builds deep core strength.
instructions: Kneel facing a stability ball with your forearms resting on top.
Brace your abs and keep your hips in line with your back.
Roll the ball forward, extending your body.
Stop before your lower back sags.
Pull the ball back in using your abs.

7211.description: A face-down hip extension combined with outward leg movement against a band.
instructions: Lie face down with the band around your ankles.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Lift both legs slightly off the floor.
Open your legs out against the band.
Bring them back together and lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

7275.description: Front plank with feet in straps, making the hold wobbly and demanding for the whole core.
instructions: Set your feet in the straps and place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold without letting your hips sag or rise.
Keep breathing steadily for the whole hold.

8299.description: A one-arm cable row from a half-kneeling stance. It works the lats and challenges your core stability.
instructions: Half kneel facing the cable with the handle in one hand.
Keep your torso tall.
Row your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

8363.description: A band rotation with the upper arm raised to shoulder height, building rotator cuff strength for overhead positions.
instructions: Anchor the band at shoulder height and hold the handle with your elbow raised to shoulder level, bent 90 degrees.
Keep the upper arm still.
Rotate your hand up and back until the forearm points to the ceiling.
Return slowly to the start.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

8619.description: A seated arm crossover that works the chest and warms up the shoulders.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Open your arms wide to the sides at shoulder height.
Sweep them together so they cross in front of your chest.
Open back out and alternate which arm is on top.

8875.description: Lying on your back with a cable strapped to one ankle, you pull the knee toward your chest. It builds hip flexor strength.
instructions: Lie on your back with the ankle strap attached to the low cable and one foot in it.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Pull the knee up toward your chest with control.
Pause briefly, then lower the leg slowly against the cable.
Keep the other leg relaxed and your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

9323.description: An air squat with a wide stance, touching a bench to guide your depth. It works the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench with your feet wide and toes turned out.
Push your hips back and lower down.
Lightly touch the bench.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

9387.description: Pressing with one leg on an angled leg press machine focuses the work on the quads and glutes.
instructions: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to push it back.
Do not lock your knee at the top.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

9451.description: A floor hold where you lie on your back with your legs and shoulders lifted about six inches. It trains deep abdominal tension and endurance.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Lift your heels and shoulders about 15 cm off the floor.
Keep your lower back flat and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower and rest.

9515.description: A seated good morning with a dumbbell held at your chest, bowing forward to train the lower back with less leg involvement.
instructions: Sit on a bench with feet flat and hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Hinge forward from the hips, keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about halfway down.
Squeeze your back and glutes to sit tall again.

10411.description: Circle a steel mace around your head while standing tall. It trains shoulder control and stability under an awkward load.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and hold the mace upright near your chest.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Circle the mace around your head in a smooth, controlled arc.
Keep your elbows close and your head still.
Do all reps, then reverse the direction.

10539.description: A seated knee extension with a light weight on the ankle. It adds load to build thigh strength.
instructions: Strap a light ankle weight on and sit tall on a chair.
Hold the seat edge for support.
Straighten the knee until your leg is level.
Hold for a second and squeeze your thigh.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

10667.description: A one-arm cable row from a kneeling position. Kneeling removes leg drive so your back does the pulling.
instructions: Set a cable at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back along your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Extend the arm slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

10731.description: A rope climb done with your legs held out in an L shape. It is a tough test for the lats, grip and abs.
instructions: Grip the rope and hang with your legs raised in front of you.
Keep your legs straight and together.
Pull with one hand over the other while staying in the L position.
Reach up and repeat.
Lower under control.
Stop if your legs drop.

10859.description: Standing with your back against a wall, you lift your toes off the floor. It strengthens the muscles on the front of the shin.
instructions: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet a little way out in front.
Keep your legs straight and your heels planted on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your toes slowly and repeat.

10987.description: A box jump holding dumbbells. It builds explosive leg power.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy box holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top.
Step down carefully and reset.

11051.description: A triceps pushdown with the cable set high and the handles crossed, using a neutral grip. It isolates the back of the arm.
instructions: Set both pulleys high and stand in the middle, holding the handles with palms facing in.
Cross your hands in front of your chest with elbows tucked to your sides.
Press the handles down and out until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the handles rise back slowly without moving your elbows.

0043.description: A deep back squat with the bar across the upper back. Builds the quads, glutes and overall leg strength.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body down.
Bend at the knees and hips, pushing your hips back and down as if sitting into a chair.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站立，双脚分开与肩同宽，脚趾稍微向外。
将杠铃放在上背部，将其放在斜方肌或三角肌后束上。
当你开始降低身体时，启动你的核心并保持胸部挺直。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，向后和向下推臀部，就像坐在椅子上一样。
放低身体，直到大腿与地面平行或稍低于地面。
保持膝盖与脚趾对齐，并将重量放在脚后跟上。
通过脚后跟站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

0107.description: A front raise where the bar travels past shoulder height up to overhead. Targets the front delts.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Slowly raise the barbell in front of you, keeping your arms straight and your palms facing down.
Continue lifting until the barbell is slightly above shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握住杠铃于大腿前方。
保持背部挺直并启动核心肌群。
慢慢地将杠铃举到你面前，保持手臂伸直，手掌朝下。
继续举起杠铃，直到杠铃略高于肩部水平。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0171.description: An incline cable fly. Targets the upper chest.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine to a low position and attach the handles.
Sit on an incline bench with your back against the pad and feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides in a controlled motion.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将电缆机调整至较低位置并安装手柄。
坐在倾斜的长凳上，背部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，并将双臂伸直至身前。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，以受控的动作向两侧张开双臂。
在完全伸展位置停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0235.description: A standing cable external rotation. The forearm turns outward while the elbow stays fixed, strengthening the rotator cuff.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the cable handle with your arm extended in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and your shoulder blades pulled back.
Slowly rotate your arm outward, away from your body, while keeping your elbow in the same position.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将手臂伸向前方，与地面平行，握住电缆手柄。
保持肘部稍微弯曲，肩胛骨向后拉。
慢慢地向外旋转手臂，远离身体，同时保持肘部处于同一位置。
动作结束时暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0299.description: A Cuban press combining an upright row, a rotation and a press. It trains the shoulders and the rotator cuff.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing down.
Keeping your core engaged and your elbows slightly bent, press the dumbbells up and overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing forward.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, rotating your wrists back to the starting position as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝下。
保持核心收紧，肘部稍微弯曲，将哑铃向上举过头顶，直到手臂完全伸展。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝前。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，同时将手腕旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0363.description: You pull one dumbbell up along your body toward chin height with the elbow leading. It trains the side shoulders and upper traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbell hang at arm's length in front of your thighs, with your palm facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住哑铃，正握。
让哑铃悬挂在大腿前面，与手臂保持一定距离，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，呼气，将哑铃笔直向上举至下巴，用肘部引导。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0427.description: Standing, you press dumbbells overhead with palms facing each other. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing inwards.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, press the dumbbells upwards until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，与肩同高，手掌朝内。
保持核心收紧，背部挺直，向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0491.description: Lying on an incline with straight legs, you raise your hips by lifting the legs. It works the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench with your back flat against the bench and your legs extended straight out in front of you.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs off the bench, raising them as high as you can while keeping them straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 躺在倾斜的长凳上，背部平放在长凳上，双腿伸直在身前。
将双手放在长凳两侧以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离长凳，尽可能抬高双腿，同时保持伸直。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0555.description: A seated core move where you lean back and kick your legs out and in. Works the abs and hip flexors without any equipment.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lean back slightly and place your hands on the edge of the bench or chair for support.
Engaging your hamstrings, lift your feet off the ground and extend your legs straight out in front of you.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly bend your knees and bring your feet back towards your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子的边缘，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
稍微向后倾斜，将双手放在长凳或椅子的边缘以获得支撑。
启动腿筋，将脚抬离地面，并将双腿伸直到身前。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢弯曲膝盖，将脚放回身体。
重复所需的重复次数。

0619.description: Lying on your back, you raise a straight leg toward the ceiling. It trains the hip muscles and leg control.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Brace your abs and press your lower back down.
Lift one straight leg to about hip height.
Lower it slowly toward the floor.
Keep the other leg flat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

0683.description: Jumping jacks with a twist added to the upper body. They raise your heart rate and engage the trunk.
instructions: Stand tall with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet wide and twist your torso to one side.
Jump back together.
Repeat and twist to the other side.
Keep your knees soft.
Maintain a steady pace.

0747.description: On the smith machine, you press the bar overhead from behind your neck. Works the shoulders and triceps, so keep it controlled.
instructions: Adjust the seat height of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder level.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Lower the bar down to the back of your neck, keeping your elbows pointing forward.
Press the bar up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整史密斯机的座椅高度，使杠铃与肩部齐平。
双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上抬起并向后退一步，保持稳定的姿势。
将杠铃降低到颈后，保持肘部向前。
将杠铃向上推过头顶，直到双臂完全伸展。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0811.description: A deadlift standing inside a hex bar, lifting by extending the hips and knees. It builds the glutes, quads and back with a friendly lifting position.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the trap bar on the ground in front of you.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower yourself down and grip the handles of the trap bar with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and chest up as you begin to lift the trap bar off the ground by extending your hips and knees.
As you lift, focus on driving through your heels and squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
Lower the trap bar back down to the ground by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将陷阱杆放在你面前的地面上。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，降低身体高度，并用正手握住陷阱杆的手柄。
当你开始通过伸展臀部和膝盖将陷阱杆抬离地面时，保持背部挺直，挺胸。
当你举起时，专注于通过脚后跟发力，并在运动的最高点挤压臀部。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，将陷阱杆放回地面，在整个运动过程中保持背部挺直。
重复所需的重复次数。
